hero.bajada: Lucide icons animated on the native Web Animations API. Zero animation dependencies, real tree-shaking, and morphing between shapes. For Angular.

showcase.descripcion: Smooth transitions between outlines. Keyframes are computed once and the browser interpolates them — zero animation loop.

api.compat: Angular {{rango}} · renders on the server (SSR), with no real window or document.

liviano.texto: Real tree-shaking. You only ship what you actually use.

api.texto: Standalone, signals, and strict typing. No NgModules.

movimiento.texto: Declarative animations on WAAPI, no heavy dependencies.

grid.rejillaAria: Icon catalog, {{n}} icons. Use the arrow keys to move between them.
grid.rejillaAriaPaginada: Icon catalog, {{n}} icons, showing {{desde}}–{{hasta}}. Use the arrow keys to move between them.
grid.holdTitulo: Has a hold variant: keep the pointer on it and the pose stays

explicacion.texto: The number on each card is how many animation variants the icon has. The hold mark means one of them stays put while the pointer is on it.

scrubber.sinScrubNota: This variant has no fixed tracks to scrub by hand — its duration is computed live by the component with getTotalLength() (autoDraw).

detalle.nota: respectReducedMotion: inherits the component's default (true) — it's not data from this choreography, it's a contract of the engine.
